journey_segments.notes: A4 east from Paris, then A31 south toward Nancy/Toul. Recommended rest stop at Aire de Sandaucourt on A31 — fuel, coffee, toilets. Toll booths: A4 Champigny, Reims, Verdun sectors.

Continue A31 south past Nancy, exit toward Épinal via N57, then N66 east to Gérardmer. Last ~30km on scenic mountain road. Studio at 175A Chemin du Tour du Lac — free parking confirmed in accommodation amenities.

cost_breakdown.notes: Fuel estimate: 440km × 7L/100km × ~1.85 EUR/L ≈ 57 EUR. Tolls A4+A31: ~25-30 EUR one way. Total ~85-93 EUR per trip.

location_change.notes_base: Self-driving Paris to Gérardmer (~440km). Route: A4 east → A31 south (Metz/Toul junction) → N57 → N66 to Gérardmer. Drive time ~4h30 including one rest stop. Suggested departure 06:30, arrival 11:00-11:30. Fuel estimate: ~50-57 EUR (440km at 7L/100km, ~1.85 EUR/L). Tolls (péages): ~25-30 EUR one way, payable via Télépéage badge (e.g. Liber-t, Ulys) or credit card at toll booths. Recommended rest stop: Aire de Sandaucourt on A31 (between Toul and Épinal exit). Studio at 175A Chemin du Tour du Lac has free private parking confirmed. May 1 is Labour Day (Fête du Travail) — driving is a good choice as trains run on reduced/holiday schedule. No booking required.
location_change.notes_local: Trajet en voiture personnelle Paris → Gérardmer (~440km). Itinéraire : A4 est → A31 sud (jonction Metz/Toul) → N57 → N66 vers Gérardmer. Durée ~4h30 avec une pause. Départ conseillé 6h30, arrivée 11h00-11h30. Carburant estimé : ~50-57€ (440km à 7L/100km, ~1,85€/L). Péages : ~25-30€ aller, payables par badge télépéage (Liber-t, Ulys) ou carte bancaire. Pause recommandée : Aire de Sandaucourt sur l'A31. Parking gratuit au studio (175A Chem. du Tour du Lac) confirmé. Le 1er mai (Fête du Travail) : bon choix car trains en service réduit. Aucune réservation nécessaire.

journey_segments.notes: D415 northwest from Orbey toward Colmar/Strasbourg, then A35 north to join A4 west. Recommended fuel stop at Reichstett service area (A4, north of Strasbourg) for return leg.
A4 west from Strasbourg to Paris. Sunday afternoon traffic may be heavy near Paris (return weekend traffic). Allow extra 30-45min buffer. Arrive Paris ~19:00-19:30.

cost_breakdown.notes: Fuel estimate: 480km × 7L/100km × ~1.85 EUR/L ≈ 62 EUR. Tolls A35+A4: ~28-32 EUR. Lac Blanc parking: ~5 EUR. Total ~93-97 EUR.

location_change.notes_base: After completing the Tour des Trois Lacs hike and lunch (~13:00-14:00), drive from Lac Blanc parking (Orbey) back to Paris (~480km, ~5h). Route: D415 northwest toward Colmar → A35 north → A4 west → Paris. Suggested departure 14:00 from Orbey, arrival Paris 19:00-19:30. Fuel estimate: ~60-62 EUR (480km at 7L/100km, ~1.85 EUR/L). Tolls (péages) A35+A4: ~28-32 EUR, payable via Télépéage badge or credit card. Lac Blanc parking fee: ~5 EUR. Recommended fuel stop: Aire de Reichstett (A4 north of Strasbourg). Sunday afternoon A4 can be congested near Paris — allow 30-45min buffer. No booking required.
location_change.notes_local: Après le Tour des Trois Lacs et le déjeuner (~13h-14h), retour en voiture depuis le parking Lac Blanc (Orbey) vers Paris (~480km, ~5h). Itinéraire : D415 nord-ouest vers Colmar → A35 nord → A4 ouest → Paris. Départ conseillé 14h depuis Orbey, arrivée Paris 19h-19h30. Carburant estimé : ~60-62€ (480km à 7L/100km, ~1,85€/L). Péages A35+A4 : ~28-32€, payables par badge télépéage (Liber-t, Ulys) ou carte bancaire. Parking Lac Blanc : ~5€. Arrêt carburant recommandé : Aire de Reichstett (A4 nord de Strasbourg). L'A4 peut être chargée en fin d'après-midi le dimanche — prévoir 30-45min de marge. Aucune réservation nécessaire.

general_notes.no_train_to_gerardmer: There is NO train station in Gérardmer. The nearest station is Remiremont (27km away). All travel to/from Gérardmer requires bus (Car Ligne 66, operated by Fluo Grand Est) or taxi from Remiremont.
general_notes.may_1_labour_day_warning: May 1 is Fête du Travail (Labour Day) — a French public holiday. SNCF trains run on Sunday/holiday schedule. Intercity buses may run reduced frequency. Verify schedules on SNCF Connect and Fluo Grand Est website before booking. Some bus lines may not operate on May 1.
general_notes.local_taxis_gerardmer: Local taxi contacts in Gérardmer: Contact via Office de Tourisme Gérardmer: +33 3 29 27 27 27. Taxi availability is limited — BOOK IN ADVANCE especially for early morning trailhead runs. No Uber in this area.
general_notes.fluo_grand_est_bus: Fluo Grand Est operates the regional bus network including Remiremont-Gérardmer service. Website: fluo.eu. Bus Line 66: Remiremont ↔ Gérardmer, journey ~35-40 min, fare ~3-5 EUR. Check schedule for May 1 holiday service.
general_notes.sncf_booking: Book TGV tickets on SNCF Connect: sncf-connect.com. Booking 2-6 weeks in advance recommended for best prices. Ouigo (budget) trains also available Paris-Nancy at lower cost.
general_notes.no_rental_car: No rental car planned. All local transportation relies on pre-booked taxis. Budget ~250-300 EUR total for all taxi rides across 3 days for 2 people.
